title: Snap launcher (catapult + ram boat)
desc: A boat construct built in one direction into the block the mob is about to step on; the mob snaps in; let go of right click to launch.

takes.name: catapult cradle
takes.facts: track builds 6-16, cradle in the mob's next block 16-28, snaps 31, release 44: arm flings it 10 blocks

takes.name: ram boat
takes.facts: same build and snap; release 44: boat rams a wall 6.5 blocks on, wall breaks, mob thrown 7 blocks

takes.name: gold catapult
takes.facts: S1 in gold, flatter faster 12-block launch
